title: Secure a Secrets Manager Secret
scenario: Store application credentials in Secrets Manager, encrypted with a rotating customer key and no recovery window.
constraints: Create a KMS key with rotation.

focus.title: Complete the aws_secretsmanager_secret resource
focus.todo: Add the arguments and nested blocks required for aws_secretsmanager_secret.

hints.why: Secrets should live in a managed secret store, not in code or state. Rotation and access policy are easier to audit there.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret" "this"`. Add the arguments and nested blocks required for aws_secretsmanager_secret. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Use a secret store for credentials and API keys that applications read at runtime.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret" "this"`. Use this code shape: name; recovery_window_in_days. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.
